description: Anime trailer: 20s cinematic trailer of a samurai's life on the Sinai mountains. LTX t2v at 64x64 generates the full audio bed (epic orchestral + Japanese instruments + trailer narration; video throwaway) + 5 anime 9:16 trailer clips (Flux keyframe -> LTX i2v) -> final cut: clips as video, score/narration as main audio, clip ambient audio ducked to 20%.
narrationScript: Beyond the edge of the map, where the desert climbs into the sky, he kept his vigil on the Sinai. A blade without a lord. A soul without a homeland. The wind carved his oath into stone. And when the storm finally came... he answered with the only language he knew. This is not a story of war. It is the legend of the last samurai of the Sinai.
narrationPrompt: Epic cinematic anime trailer soundscape, 20 seconds. A powerful orchestral score: low rumbling taiko drums, deep solo shakuhachi flute theme, soaring strings, sparse koto plucks, desert wind and heat shimmer, a single resonant katana draw and a sword on stone, distant thunder rolling over mountains. On top, a deep gravelly male narrator in his 40s speaks like a movie trailer voice — slow, weighty, intimate, with dramatic pauses between phrases, never rushed. Warm close-mic voice, subtle large-hall reverb, clean mix, voice clearly on top of the music, music swells under the final line. The narrator says, slowly and clearly: "Beyond the edge of the map, where the desert climbs into the sky, he kept his vigil on the Sinai. A blade without a lord. A soul without a homeland. The wind carved his oath into stone. And when the storm finally came... he answered with the only language he knew. This is not a story of war. It is the legend of the last samurai of the Sinai."
